swingCancel.label: Swing cancel
swingCancel.description: Block or dodge out of a melee attack during its wind-up, heavy attacks included. You stay committed only during the swing itself, and recover sooner after it.

armourDefence.label: Stronger armour
armourDefence.description: Multiplies the physical and magical defence of every armour piece. Each armour type keeps its own balance between the two.

armourDefenceMultiplier.label: Armour multiplier
armourDefenceMultiplier.description: How much stronger armour gets: 1.25 means 25% more defence.
